svg.aria-label: About Ignacio Breñas Muñoz — Proactive Software Developer holding up in production. Software Developer & DAW student in Barcelona with a versatile foundation across web engineering, client-server OOP architecture, AI & data analysis (Pandas, Power BI), and virtualized Docker/WSL/Linux deployments. At Soterguard I participate in Stoam Connect — connecting B2B & B2C platforms with CRMs and ERPs — alongside On-Premise client systems, building on my SMR degree (9.18/10) at STUCOM Pelai.
